userStories.title: Add Privacy page component
userStories.description: As a user, I want a Privacy Policy page so that I can read the application's privacy information.
acceptanceCriteria: File exports a React component named `Privacy`
Component renders an `<h1>` with text "Privacy Policy"
Component includes sections with headings "1. Information Collection", "2. Use of Information", and "3. Third-Party Links"
Component renders the exact static content as specified
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
